# 3 bedroom terraced house for sale

> Set within a convenient and well-regarded part of Gorleston, this modern three-storey townhouse is offered with no onward chain and can be purchased fully furnished if required, making it an ideal turnkey home or investment. The property offers a versatile layout, generous room sizes and attractive river and sea views from the front aspect.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms
- Plocha: 83 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Riverside Road, Great Yarmouth
- Cena: £260,000
